channel.title: Morning Brief · Dinero y economía personal
channel.description: Tasas, inflación, empleo, crédito, impuestos y fraudes que afectan tu bolsillo

item.title: Chinese tech giant Huawei is guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets, US jury finds
item.description: The verdict follows a months-long trial in New York. [Confirmado] Fuentes: Associated Press, BBC News, Bloomberg

item.title: US consumer confidence soars with elections in the rearview mirror and gas prices in retreat
item.description: Rise occurs amid soaring energy prices, according to last inflation reading before a crucial Fed board meeting Consumer prices rose an annualized 3.8% in October, according to new inflation data released on Wednesday, the highest since… [Confirmado] Fuentes: Associated Press, Reuters, Bloomberg

item.title: Britons face soaring energy bills after 26% price cap hike
item.description: A household using a typical amount of energy would see its annual bill rise from £1,723 to £2,166 if this level was sustained for a year. [Probable] Fuentes: Reuters, BBC News, Financial Times

item.title: Australian Inflation Accelerates, Even After RBA Rate Hikes
item.description: The personal consumption expenditures price index was expected to show an annual inflation rate of 3.8% in October, according to the Dow Jones consensus. [Probable] Fuentes: Bloomberg, CNBC, The Hill

item.title: Russia backs tax rises as 2027 budget sees military spending soar
item.description: Russia’s lower house of parliament has approved a 2027-2029 state budget and passed tax increases to fund the war in Ukraine [Probable] Fuentes: Associated Press, Bloomberg, ABC News

item.title: Russia's own figures show it has lost nearly 500,000 people in Ukraine war
item.description: Leaked data reveal how the full-scale invasion of Ukraine has fundamentally changed mortality patterns in Russia. [Probable] Fuentes: BBC News, CNBC
